items.title: Rams bring back K Joshua Karty, LS Jake McQuaide on practice squad
items.text: The Rams have turned to a couple of their former players to help solve their special teams woes.

items.title: Jesse Minter: Lamar Jackson "was able to get some work in" on Wednesday
items.text: Baltimore's HC stayed tight-lipped about Jackson's participation status after the QB was on the field to start the practice week.

items.title: Garrett Wilson: I want to win, hopeful I can do it with Jets
items.text: Jets wide receiver Garrett Wilson's frustrations boiled over on the sideline during last Sunday's loss to the Dolphins, but he said on Wednesday that he's not looking for a move to another team ahead of the November 10 trade deadline.

items.title: Mike McDaniel will remain the Chargers' offensive playcaller
items.text: Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh said that the team would spend their bye week "looking into everything" when it came to improving their offense and did not rule out a change involving offensive coordinator Mike McDaniel.

items.title: NFL rules forced Saquon Barkley to sell his interest in Polymarket
items.text: When it comes to the gold rush of sports betting and prediction markets, player investment continues to be the forbidden fruit.

items.title: Matthew Golden, Devonte Wyatt questionable for Thursday night
items.text: Wide receiver Matthew Golden moved up to a limited listing on Wednesday's injury report and the Packers are hoping to have him in the lineup on Thursday night as well.

items.title: Shane Steichen: Jonathan Taylor's on our football team, hasn't asked for a trade
items.text: Colts running back Jonathan Taylor's future in Indianapolis is the subject of much scrutiny right now, but head coach Shane Steichen said on Wednesday that Taylor isn't looking for an immediate exit.

items.title: Cardinals sign Kingsley Eguakun to 53-man roster, Zay Jones to practice squad
items.text: The Cardinals have made a couple of roster moves on Wednesday.

items.title: Panthers rule Jaelan Phillips out for Thursday night
items.text: The Panthers will be shorthanded on defense in Green Bay on Thursday night.

items.title: If Jonathan Taylor is available in trade, the Colts could hold him out of action on Sunday
items.text: The Colts are open for business, as evidenced by the Tuesday trades that sent offensive lineman Quenton Nelson to the Seahawks and defensive tackle DeForest Buckner to the 49ers.

items.title: Lions open Kerby Joseph's 21-day practice window
items.text: More help is on the way for Detroit's defense.

items.title: Some owners are spending big on the midterm elections
items.text: With all the talk about asses and advertisements, it's easy to forget that a fairly important election is coming in six days.

items.title: Matt LaFleur understands the challenges of officiating NFL games
items.text: The Packers were on the wrong end of some questionable calls during Sunday's loss to the Lions.

items.title: Harrison Butker will "probably" kick for the Chiefs this week
items.text: The Chiefs signed veteran kicker Justin Tucker to their practice squad on Wednesday, but he's unlikely to be handling their kicking duties against the Broncos this week.

items.title: Josh Downs on trade request: "I'm open to whatever"
items.text: Downs did not explicitly confirm he'd requested a trade, but he didn't reject the notion of playing elsewhere when asked on Wednesday.

items.title: Chiefs expect Rashee Rice, Jaylon Moore to practice Wednesday
items.text: The Chiefs are getting healthier as they try to bounce back from their first loss of the 2026 season.

items.title: Report: Colts WR Josh Downs requests a trade
items.text: The request comes a day after the trades of Quenton Nelson and DeForest Buckner.

items.title: Commanders put Terry McLaurin on IR, sign Van Jefferson to active roster
items.text: The Commanders announced that wide receiver Terry McLaurin will miss the rest of the season after their Week 6 loss to the 49ers, but they kept him on the roster during their bye week.

items.title: One year after the Chargers shredded the Vikings on a Thursday night, the teams are in very different spots
items.text: Week 8 arrives on Thursday night, with the Packers hosting the Panthers.

items.title: Bengals P Ryan Rehkow is the AFC special teams player of the week
items.text: The Bengals' offensive explosion in the second half in Baltimore last Sunday got the most attention, but they also got a strong effort on special teams from punter Ryan Rehkow.

items.title: D.J. Wonnum named NFC special teams player of the week
items.text: The Lions were able to defeat the Packers in part due to a blocked field goal on Sunday.

items.title: Broncos LB Alex Singleton named the AFC defensive player of the week
items.text: The Broncos won their third straight game last Sunday and linebacker Alex Singleton played a key defensive role in the victory.

items.title: Blake Cashman named NFC defensive player of the week
items.text: The undefeated Vikings have earned an honor.

items.title: Joe Burrow is the AFC offensive player of the week for the ninth time
items.text: Bengals quarterback Joe Burrow only had one good half in last Sunday's game against the Ravens, but it was a really good half.

items.title: Michael Penix Jr. wins first NFC offensive player of the week award
items.text: The Falcons got a big win over the 49ers and now their quarterback has been recognized for his performance.

items.title: Liam Coen: Colts traded away two good players right before we play them, can't deny that
items.text: Jaguars head coach Liam Coen acknowledged that his team's task got a little easier when the Colts traded away two of their top players, offensive lineman Quenton Nelson and defensive lineman DeForest Buckner.

items.title: Jerry Jones: Troy Aikman working for Cowboys in future is "very possible"
items.text: Troy Aikman was in Philadelphia to call Monday night's game between the Cowboys and the Eagles and he took some time before it got underway to catch up with his first boss in the NFL.

items.title: Report: Jaylen Waddle aggravated previous chest injury, Week 8 status TBD
items.text: Broncos head coach Sean Payton criticized himself for the play call that ended with receiver Jaylen Waddle suffering a chest injury.

items.title: Giants GM Joe Schoen on trades: We're looking, but has to make sense now and in future
items.text: The Giants hit their bye week in first place in the NFC East with a 4-2-1 record and that's made the prospect of bolstering the roster in the trade market a popular topic of conversation around the team.

items.title: Chiefs to sign Justin Tucker to their practice squad
items.text: Tucker has been out of the league since being released by the Ravens in May 2025.
